output.summary: The 30% revenue fall is concentrated in 2023-24, when concerts moved to the smaller Brightwater venue (40% fewer seats, poor transit). Single-ticket sales fell 45% and low-attendance subscribers' renewal fell from 60% to 43%. Lapsed patrons mainly cite travel (41%), and the cathedral near rail sold far better. Peers with no move also fell about 29%, but gradually and with single tickets down only 9%, so the venue effect is likely additional to a regional trend. Programming shows no per-concert sales effect, and the committed core renews at about 85%. Marketing is untested because there is no attribution data. A non-renewal notice or a repertoire cut is unsupported. The segmented analysis and the cathedral and shuttle pilot are the best next steps.
